m1-scaffold-refusals.title: Module scaffold: WeekendUtilizationPrior + join_weekend_prior loud refusals + fully-thin path
m1-scaffold-refusals.imperative: Create src/physics/fingerprint/join.py with the frozen WeekendUtilizationPrior dataclass and join_weekend_prior signature. Implement ALL loud-refusal input validation (vocabulary-version mismatch, channel mismatch, driver mismatch, class-order mismatch, missing composition key, corner_share<=0 -> each ValueError) and the zero-resolved fully-thin path (prior=None, mean=None, weight_on_thin=1.0, thin_classes=all class_ids). m2-join-sigma.title: Resolved join arithmetic + quadrature sigma propagation (T7 invariants)
m2-join-sigma.imperative: Implement the resolved path: normalized-weighted-average prior_mean (== mu_res; unresolved fall back to mu_res), quadrature combined_scale = sqrt(sum_res w_i^2 sigma_i^2 + (weight_on_thin*sigma_unres)^2) with sigma_unres = max(pstdev(resolved means) [range/2 if <2], max_resolved_sigma), weight-aware n_eff_res = 1/sum_res(w_i^2/support_i) then n_eff = n_eff_res*(1-weight_on_thin) floored, wrapped in predictive_t. Append T7-1..T7-5, sigma thin-widening (numeric strictly-wider), sigma monotonicity, thin surfacing, both-channels-symmetric tests. TDD red (NotImplementedError) first, then green.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: T7 + sigma invariant tests written and observed failing (resolved path stubbed) — manual attest
full test_join.py green (all T7 invariants + T7-5 + sigma widening/monotonicity/surfacing/channel symmetry)

constraints: sigma_unres MUST be able to EXCEED resolved sigma (widen, never cap)
n_eff folds in thin weight so the tail fattens

m3-verify.title: Final verification: full pytest green + simplification_limits pass
m3-verify.imperative: Run the full test file and simplification_limits on both new files from the worktree. Both must pass (exit 0). Paste outputs into the IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
constraints: Do NOT commit/stage; do NOT touch data/*.db or docs/architecture/*

why_trail.why: Seams verified against source: FingerprintCell fields (driver,era,vocabulary_version,class_id,channel,what_measure,mean,sigma,support_n,status,shared_floor_applied,format_version); ClassVocabulary(vocabulary_id,rules_era,k,class_ids,f12_verdict,f12_provenance); predictive_t(mu,sigma,n_eff,*,nu_loss,rule)->PredictiveT(nu,loc,scale); FormulaRule nu_prior=2.5>NU_FLOOR so any n_eff>0 valid. Handoff complete: task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop all present. Note: simplification CLI uses --paths (handoff bare-positional form is wrong).

join.py scaffold: WeekendUtilizationPrior frozen dataclass + join_weekend_prior with all 6 loud refusals (class-order, driver, channel, vocab-version, missing-comp-key, corner_share<=0) and the fully-thin path (resolved_weight<=0 -> prior/mean None, weight_on_thin=1.0, thin_classes=all). Resolved math stubbed to NotImplementedError for m2. 7/7 m1 tests green.

Resolved path: prior_mean=mu_res (normalized weighted avg over resolved, unresolved fall back so mean==mu_res); combined_scale quadrature sqrt(Sum_res w^2 sigma^2 + (weight_on_thin*sigma_unres)^2), sigma_unres=max(pstdev(resolved means) or range/2, max_resolved_sigma) so unknown class widens; n_eff=n_eff_res*(1-weight_on_thin) floored. 18/18 green incl T7-1..5 + thin-widening/monotonicity/surfacing/channel-symmetry.

Final verification: full test_join.py 18/18 green (engine c1 command) and simplification_limits PASS on join.py + test_join.py (engine c2 command). Both run from the worktree with the pinned interpreter.
